response:
쿼리 작성: WITH zips_strict AS (
  SELECT geolocation_zip_code_prefix AS zip
  FROM geolocation
  GROUP BY geolocation_zip_code_prefix
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT geolocation_state) = 1
)
SELECT
  c.customer_state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_city) AS city_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.zip IN (SELECT z.zip FROM zips_strict z WHERE z.zip = c.customer_zip_code_prefix) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zip_count
FROM customers c
JOIN geolocation g
  ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
JOIN zips_strict z
  ON z.zip = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
WHERE g.geolocation_lat < (SELECT AVG(geolocation_lat) FROM geolocation g2
                           WHERE g2.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
                           GROUP BY g2.geolocation_zip_code_prefix)
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY customer_count DESC, c.customer_state;

  SELECT
    geolocation_state,
    AVG(geolocation_lat) AS avg_lat
  FROM geolocation
  GROUP BY geolocation_state
)

  g.geolocation_state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_city) AS customer_city_count
FROM customers c
JOIN geolocation g
  ON g.geolocation_zip_code_prefix = c.customer_zip_code_prefix
JOIN state_avg s
  ON s.geolocation_state = g.geolocation_state
WHERE g.geolocation_lat < s.avg_lat
GROUP BY g.geolocation_state
ORDER BY g.geolocation_state;
